about_the_game:
Prison Escape Simulator is a single-player Parkour , Escape and Survival game.

Run, Kill, Hide, Find the Right Path and Escape from the Island

Story of the Game

The prisoner will be executed. His only remedy is to escape from prison.

Everything is in your hands. Survive and escape.

Will you be able to save the prisoner?

The survival-themed escape game will take your breath away. Experience an action adventure with limitless play. Explore the mysterious island. And find your escape route.

Exciting Parkour

Enjoy the downward parkour. Show your skills.

Escape the maze

Find a way to escape the maze.

Learn to use a helicopter, parachute, and boat.

A Unique Experience

Enjoy the joy of descending from the mountain, examine security cameras, let yourself go with the flow of the story, fight with different weapons and survive.

Experience a different experience with unlimited different game endings, unlimited different escape routes every time you try. Add to your wishlist to be the first to experience the unique game type
